11. Despite its use in the EqA 2010, the term “transsexual” is generally considered to be
outdated, as it is associated with a medicalised approach. It is generally preferable for the
judge to use the term which the person concerned is comfortable with (whilst balancing the
needs of other court users to give their best evidence).
